get.description: Finds video matches in Reka Vision by embedding query.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

explanation.description: Explanation of the video chunk content and its relevance to the search query

plainTextCaption.description: Text caption for the video chunk

plainTextTranscript.description: Transcription of speech in the video chunk

s3PresignedUrl.description: Presigned S3 URL to access the parent video

userId.description: User ID who owns the video

videoChunkId.description: Unique identifier for the video chunk

videoThumbnails.description: URL (typically VTT) pointing to generated storyboard thumbnails

videoTitle.description: Title stored in the video's metadata

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.
